briefing: Markets were quietly positive today with NASDAQ +0.8% and S&P 500 +0.4% — not a strong risk-on day, but two candidates showed every bullish signal at once (momentum, trend, and volume), so we used two of our three open slots rather than letting cash sit idle. We avoided piling into multiple Bitcoin-mining names to keep correlation risk in check.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Multi-signal confirmation means only acting on a trade idea when several independent technical indicators — like RSI, MACD, price trend, and trading volume — all point the same direction at once. This reduces the chance of chasing a false signal caused by random short-term noise.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 多重訊號確認是指只有在多個獨立技術指標（如RSI、MACD、價格趨勢及成交量）同時指向同一方向時才進行交易。這樣可以減少因短期隨機波動而追錯訊號的機會。

market_education.summary_en: Today's modest gains in the NASDAQ (+0.8%) and S&P 500 (+0.4%) reflect a calm, grind-higher session without a single dominant catalyst. Crypto-adjacent names led the screener's momentum rankings, suggesting renewed risk appetite in smaller-cap growth names even as broad indices moved only slightly. No major scheduled macro events appear to have driven today's action based on available data.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日納指(+0.8%)及標普500(+0.4%)溫和上揚，市況平靜，未見單一主導消息帶動。篩選名單中以加密貨幣相關股份動能最強，反映中小型增長股的風險偏好有所回升，惟大盤指數僅輕微上移。目前未見有重大宏觀消息觸發今日走勢。

trades.reasoning: Top-scored candidate (100) with full signal confirmation — bullish RSI, MACD crossover, rising histogram, price above SMA-20, and volume surge.
Also scores 100 with the same multi-signal confirmation, and diversifies crypto exposure away from pure mining into digital-asset financial services.
